name: 마법 찻잔 카페
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly enchanted tea salon, gentle elevated view through a broad opening onto floating steaming teacups above a tiered cake on a silver tray; open central foreground, warm teacup steam catches amber café lighting against cool moonlit window panes, richly detailed porcelain and frosting texture, atmospheric soft steam, polished fantasy concept art, the whole salon glowing with painterly cinematic charm.
